findings.summary: Adopting a repo never succeeds: three attempts across two different repos all fail at 'pnpm install' in the product's staging harness (mission-control fails with 'ERROR packages field missing or empty'). The page calls it a 'harness malfunction' and says retrying is safe, but retries fail identically, so a returning user cannot bring a new repo into the system at all.

Clicking the mode toggle 'Adopt a repo' while a repo path is already typed silently discards the typed path and resets the form to prompt mode with no confirmation or feedback; the user's entered data is lost without warning. The toggle and the 'Adopt' submit button also have overlapping accessible names, making the wrong target easy to hit.
The adoption failure page offers no retry button; to try again the user must navigate back to Home and re-type the full repo path from scratch.

Data that was accepted persisted intact: both failed adoption run records (including the repo paths exactly as typed, character for character) survived a page reload and a fresh new-tab session, and failed adoptions left no orphan project stubs in the Missions list.
